title: Towards Measuring and Modeling “Culture” in LLMs: A Survey
reasoning: This paper is a survey that specifically categorizes research into cultural proxies, including religion as a demographic proxy and 'emotions and values' (incorporating ethics and morals) as a semantic proxy. The appendix provides numerous examples of black-box probing prompts used to evaluate moral principles and ethical decision-making (e.g., Heinz's dilemma and Timmy's dilemma) in LLMs.
